processing.description: Read the sheet '2025_Report _Data_Global' of the indicator 1.1.1 (attributable heatwave days) workbook of the Lancet Countdown 2025 report, 2020–2024: heatwave days observed, expected without climate change (Counterfactual) and attributable to climate change (Attributable_to_CC), published as in the workbook.
Checked that observed days equal expected days plus attributable days in every year.

scope.basis: A heatwave is at least two consecutive days when both minimum and maximum temperature exceed the local 1986–2005 95th percentile. Observed days from ERA5; days expected without human-caused warming from 24 paired CMIP6 climate model simulations.

title: Heatwave days per person, observed and attributable to climate change, world
